component: Qwen4 eager layer dispatch policy and observability
license_basis: Source repository LICENSE; Qwen4 model architecture notes its Apache-2.0 Transformers origin
modifications: Retained the existing Qwen4 per-layer mx.async_eval mechanism and made enablement, maximum forward rows, and layer stride explicit FlashNextPolicy fields instead of a hard-coded adapter environment choice.
Added bounded engaged-forward and oversized-forward-decline counters, an adapter diagnostic status object, and Prometheus event export.
Added bit-identity, dispatch-stride, row-bound decline, environment mapping, and fail-closed policy validation tests.
Selected stride 2 after two interleaved real-model GPU sweeps found it consistently faster than strides 1 and 4 while remaining bit exact; final current-source qualification is recorded separately.
Did not add or modify any prefix-cache engine; APCv2 remains the only serving prefix-cache path.
